info.title: Coinbase Advanced Trade WebSocket
info.description:
Subscribe to channels for real-time market data and (with a JWT) a user's
orders, positions, and futures balances.

Most channels close within 60-90 seconds if no updates are sent. Subscribe to
the `heartbeats` channel alongside others to keep all subscriptions open.

Only the `user` channel accepts `-USDC` product IDs. Other channels return the
same data as the matching `-USD` product. `USDT-USDC` and `EURC-USDC` are
available on every channel.

heartbeats.title: Heartbeats
heartbeats.description:
Real-time server pings (every second) to keep all connections open. Each
message carries a heartbeat_counter so clients can detect missed messages.
No products or authentication required.

candles.title: Candles
candles.description:
Real-time updates on product candles, grouped into five-minute buckets,
with updates every second.

status.title: Product status
status.description:
Sends all products and currencies on a preset interval. Provide the
product_ids you want status for.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description:
Real-time price updates every time a match happens. Batches updates during
cascading matches to reduce bandwidth.

ticker_batch.title: Ticker (batched)
ticker_batch.description:
Latest price updates every 5000 milliseconds (5 seconds) when there is a
change. Same schema as the ticker channel except the envelope channel is
ticker_batch and best bid / best ask fields are not provided.

level2.title: Level 2 order book
level2.description:
Guarantees delivery of all updates and is the easiest way to keep an order
book snapshot in sync. Subscribe with channel level2; received messages
carry channel l2_data. new_quantity is the updated size at a price level
(not a delta); a value of "0" means the level can be removed.

market_trades.title: Market trades
market_trades.description:
Real-time trades for the subscribed products. Updates are collected over
the last 250 ms and sent together, so an update may contain one or many
trades.

user.title: User orders and positions
user.description:
Authenticated. Sends updates on a user's open orders and current
positions, including all subsequent updates. This is the only channel that
accepts `-USDC` product IDs.

One connection per user. `product_ids` is optional; omit it for all products.
To add products, unsubscribe and open a new connection with the expanded list.

Open orders arrive in the snapshot batched by 50. The first message with fewer
than 50 orders is the last of that snapshot.

futures_balance_summary.title: Futures balance summary
futures_balance_summary.description:
Authenticated. Sends updates on all of a user's US futures balances,
including subsequent updates. No products required.

TickerBatch.description: Same as Ticker but without best bid/ask fields.

start.description: String representation of the UNIX timestamp of the candle.

high.description: Highest price during the bucket interval.

low.description: Lowest price during the bucket interval.

open.description: Price of the first trade in the bucket.

close.description: Price of the last trade in the bucket.

volume.description: Base amount traded during this interval.

event_time.description: Time of the event as recorded by the trading engine.

new_quantity.description: Updated size at this price level (not a delta). A value of "0" means the level can be removed.

side.description: The maker's side of the trade.

avg_price.description: Average filled price of the order so far.

client_order_id.description: Unique identifier of the order specified by the client.

contract_expiry_type.description: Contract expiry type for the order.

cumulative_quantity.description: Amount the order is filled, in base currency.

leaves_quantity.description: Amount remaining, in the same currency the order was placed in (quote or base).

limit_price.description: Limit price when the order is a Limit or Stop Limit type; "0" otherwise.

number_of_fills.description: Number of fills for the order.

outstanding_hold_amount.description: Outstanding hold amount for the order.

product_id.description: The product this order was placed on.

retail_portfolio_id.description: The ID of the portfolio this order is associated with.

risk_managed_by.description: Who manages the risk for this order.

status.description: Current order state. PENDING is not yet open; OPEN is waiting to fill; FILLED is 100% filled; CANCEL_QUEUED is queued for cancellation by the user or the system; CANCELLED has been cancelled; EXPIRED means a TWAP was not filled by its expiry; FAILED means the order could not be placed.

stop_price.description: Stop price when the order is a Stop Limit type; "0" otherwise.

time_in_force.description: Time in force of the order.

total_value_after_fees.description: Total value of the order after fees.

end_time.description: Order end time, or 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when not applicable.

start_time.description: Order start time, or 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when not applicable.

Positions.description: Futures and prediction-market positions for the user. Numeric values are in USDC. This object is beta and empty by default; enable it through CDP Discord (https://discord.com/invite/cdp).

prediction_market_positions.description: Prediction-market positions. Beta; currently returned as an empty array.

product_id.description: Instrument the position is in, e.g. BTC-PERP-INTX.

portfolio_uuid.description: The uuid of the portfolio this position is associated with.

vwap.description: Price of the position based on the last settlement period.

entry_vwap.description: Volume-weighted entry price of the position (not reset to the last funding price).

net_size.description: Size of the position; positive is long, negative is short.

buy_order_size.description: Cumulative size of all open buy orders.

sell_order_size.description: Cumulative size of all open sell orders.

mark_price.description: Current mark price for the instrument, used in risk and margin calculations.

liquidation_price.description: Price at which the position will be liquidated.

im_notional.description: Amount this position contributes to the initial margin.

mm_notional.description: Amount this position contributes to the maintenance margin.

unrealized_pnl.description: Profit or loss of this position (resets to 0 after settlement).

aggregated_pnl.description: Total profit or loss of this position since it was opened.

product_id.description: Instrument the position is in, e.g. BTC-12Jun24-CDE.

number_of_contracts.description: Size of the position in contracts.

unrealized_pnl.description: Current unrealized PnL for the position.

entry_price.description: Average entry price of the position.

futures_buying_power.description: Cash balance available to trade US futures.

total_usd_balance.description: Aggregate USD across your CFTC-regulated futures account and your Coinbase Inc. spot account.

cbi_usd_balance.description: USD maintained in your Coinbase Inc. spot account.

cfm_usd_balance.description: USD in your CFTC-regulated futures account; not available to trade spot.

total_open_orders_hold_amount.description: Total balance on hold for spot and futures open orders.

unrealized_pnl.description: Current unrealized PnL across all open positions.

daily_realized_pnl.description: Realized PnL from the current trade date, including profit or loss from positions closed today.

initial_margin.description: Margin required to initiate futures positions. Once futures orders are placed, these funds cannot be used to trade spot; the amount needed to support executed orders is moved to the futures account.

available_margin.description: Funds available to meet the anticipated margin requirement: Coinbase Inc. spot USD, US futures USD, and futures PnL, less holds for open spot or futures orders.

liquidation_threshold.description: When available collateral drops to this threshold, some or all futures positions are liquidated.

liquidation_buffer_amount.description: Funds available in excess of the liquidation threshold (available margin minus liquidation threshold). At 0, futures positions and/or open orders are liquidated as necessary.

liquidation_buffer_percentage.description: Funds available in excess of the liquidation threshold, as a percentage. At 0%, futures positions and/or open orders are liquidated as necessary.

intraday_margin_window_measure.description: Margin requirements for positions held intraday before settling overnight.

overnight_margin_window_measure.description: Increased margin requirements for positions held unsettled overnight.

margin_window_type.description: The margin window this measure applies to.

liquidation_buffer_percentage.description: Liquidation buffer percentage for this window.

futures_buying_power.description: Futures buying power for this window.
